bullets.text: Crypto Travel Rule Enforced — The UK has implemented the Crypto Travel Rule, requiring Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASPs) to enhance transparency in digital asset transactions, impacting compliance efforts.

AI Governance Evolution — Singapore's Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) is shifting towards evidence-based AI governance, affecting financial institutions' compliance strategies and operational frameworks.

New Retail Disclosure Framework — The UK's Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) is introducing a Consumer-Centric Investment (CCI) regime, changing how retail investment products are disclosed to consumers.
EU Supervisory Reporting Reform — The European Banking Authority (EBA) is simplifying supervisory reporting requirements, aiming to reduce costs and improve data management for banks across Europe.
Transforming Chief Data Offices — The role of Chief Data Officers (CDOs) is evolving to focus on demonstrating commercial value and operational efficiency in data management.
